# Do you still owe a beneficial ownership report?

> Free checker for whether your company still owes a federal Corporate Transparency Act beneficial ownership report after FinCEN's August 2026 final rule permanently exempted every U.S.-formed entity. Applies to foreign-formed entities registered to do business in the U.S. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
